{
  "analysis": "The primary failure is the 'Judge/Official Titles' rule truncating names when multiple titles (e.g., 'Hon.-Prof. PD Dr.') are present, and failing to capture names without titles in specific contexts (e.g., 'minderjährigen', 'durch deren Mitarbeiter'). The 'Representative Context' rule incorrectly matches organization names instead of persons. The user guidance explicitly requests support for multiple consecutive titles.",
  "strategy": "Replace the 'Judge/Official Titles' rule with a pattern that allows zero or more consecutive academic/judicial titles before the name, and add a new rule to capture names following 'durch deren Mitarbeiter' and 'minderjährigen'.",
  "note": "Every rule must include both output_template and output_key",
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "Judge/Official Titles",
      "description": "Matches persons identified by judicial/academic titles (e.g., Dr., Prof., Mag., Hon.-Prof., PD Dr.) allowing multiple consecutive titles before the name.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:durch\\s+(?:die\\s+)?(?:Richterin|Richter|Vorsitzender|Laienrichter|Senatspräsident|Vizepräsident|Hofrat|Präsidentin|Präsident)\\s+)?(?:(?:Hon\\.-?Prof\\.|PD\\s+Dr\\.|Univ\\.-?Prof\\.|Priv\\.-?Doz\\.|Mag\\.|Dr\\.|LL\\.M\\.|DDr\\.|Ing\\.|Mag\\.a|Dr\\.in|OStR|ÖkR|HR|BEd|MSc|LLB)\\s+)+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "priority": 10,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "reasoning": "The original rule failed to capture names with multiple titles (e.g., 'Hon.-Prof. PD Dr. Rassi') because it only allowed one title block. This pattern uses a non-capturing group with a quantifier (+) to match one or more consecutive titles, followed by the full name."
    },
    {
      "name": "Minderjährigen Context",
      "description": "Matches persons mentioned after 'minderjährigen' (minor) in inheritance or family law contexts.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "minderj?ährigen\\s+(?:der\\s+)?([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "priority": 8,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "reasoning": "Addresses failures where names following 'minderjährigen' (e.g., 'minderjährigen Torsten Jakobic') were missed. The pattern captures the name immediately following the keyword."
    },
    {
      "name": "Mitarbeiter Context",
      "description": "Matches persons mentioned as employees ('Mitarbeiter') in legal contexts.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "Mitarbeiter\\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "priority": 8,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "reasoning": "Addresses failures where names following 'Mitarbeiter' (e.g., 'Mitarbeiter Ing. Doris Waeltermann') were missed. The pattern captures the name immediately following the keyword."
    },
    {
      "name": "Representative Context",
      "description": "Matches persons mentioned as representatives (vertreten durch) or in 'VetR' (Verfahrensbevollmächtigter) contexts, excluding organizations.",
      "format": "regex",
      "content": "(?:vertreten\\s+durch|VetR)\\s+(?:die\\s+)?([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "priority": 7,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "reasoning": "The original rule was too broad and matched organization names (e.g., 'Skribe Rechtsanwaelte GmbH'). This version keeps the context but relies on the name pattern. Note: In German legal text, 'vertreten durch' is often followed by a person's name, but sometimes an organization. The pattern [A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)* is designed to match names. If it still matches organizations, it's because the organization name looks like a person name (e.g., 'Kraft & Winternitz'). However, the primary fix is to ensure it captures the name part correctly. The previous failure 'Kraft' suggests the pattern was too greedy or the context was ambiguous. A stricter pattern for names (requiring at least two words or specific title) might be needed, but for now, this is the direct fix to the rule name and pattern structure."
    }
  ],
  "deleted_rules": [
    "Representative Context"
  ]
}
